title: Wegener presents continental drift in Frankfurt
summary: On 6 January 1912 the German meteorologist Alfred Wegener lectured to the Geologische Vereinigung in Frankfurt, first setting out publicly his idea that the continents had moved. Printed versions appeared the same year, and he expanded the argument in his 1915 book on the origin of continents and oceans.
